column1: # Partition table for the CrowPanel 7" HMI (4 MB flash) — OTA-capable.
# Tier 4 replaced the single-slot `huge_app.csv` (one 3 MB app
# network update) with two app slots so ArduinoOTA / espota can write a new
# image into the inactive slot and swap on reboot (see src/ota.cpp).
# This project stores everything in NVS (Preferences) and uses no filesystem
# so there is no SPIFFS/LittleFS partition — that space goes to the app slots
# instead
# `min_spiffs.csv` layout's 0x1E0000 (1.875 MB). The firmware must fit within
# one app slot; if it ever grows past ~1.94 MB the build will fail at the
# image-size check.
# App partitions must start on a 0x10000 (64 KB) boundary — 0x10000 and
# 0x200000 both qualify. The trailing 0x10000 goes to a coredump partition for
# crash post-mortems (matches this project's diagnostic bent).
# nvs stays at 0x9000/0x5000 so settings saved under the old huge_app layout
# survive the switch (same offset + size as huge_app.csv / the Arduino default).
# Name
nvs
otadata
app0
app1
coredump
